bash: echo "--- dist-info contents ---"; ls -la /usr/local/lib/python3.13/site-packages/pip-24.3.1.dist-info/
echo "--- RECORD head ---"; head -20 /usr/local/lib/python3.13/site-packages/pip-24.3.1.dist-info/RECORD 2>&1
echo "--- record line count ---"; wc -l /usr/local/lib/python3.13/site-packages/pip-24.3.1.dist-info/RECORD 2>&1
echo "--- how many of those files exist? ---"; python3 - <<'EOF'
import os
base="/usr/local/lib/python3.13/site-packages"
rec=base+"/pip-24.3.1.dist-info/RECORD"
try:
    lines=open(rec).read().splitlines()
except Exception as e:
    print("no RECORD:",e); raise SystemExit
missing=0; present=0
for l in lines:
    p=l.split(",")[0]
    if not p: continue
    full=os.path.join(base,p) if not os.path.isabs(p) else p
    if os.path.exists(full): present+=1
    else: missing+=1
print("recorded:",len(lines),"present:",present,"missing:",missing)
EOF
